LESSON: DUKANI

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.20: Dukani

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Dukani. Soma kwa makini, angalia mifano, kisha fanya mazoezi na jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua msamiati wa dukani ili kuutumia katika mawasiliano
2. kusoma maneno yanayohusiana na shughuli za dukani ili kujenga usomaji bora
3. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa dukani ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza
4. kutumia msamiati wa dukani katika sentensi sahihi ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na uuzaji na ununuzi ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma 105 f) kuthamini shughuli za biashara. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua msamiati wa dukani ili kuutumia katika mawasiliano
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutambua msamiati wa dukani ili kuutumia katika mawasiliano. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. kusoma maneno yanayohusiana na shughuli za dukani ili kujenga usomaji bora
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kusoma maneno yanayohusiana na shughuli za dukani ili kujenga usomaji bora. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa dukani ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kueleza maana ya msamiati wa dukani ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. kutumia msamiati wa dukani katika sentensi sahihi ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na uuzaji na ununuzi ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma 105 f) kuthamini shughuli za biashara. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutumia msamiati wa dukani katika sentensi sahihi ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na uuzaji na ununuzi ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma 105 f) kuthamini shughuli za biashara. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Mfano 1: Asubuhi shuleni, salimu mwalimu: “Shikamoo.” Mwalimu atasema: “Marahaba.”

Mfano 2: Sikiliza hadithi fupi kisha mweleze rafiki yako jambo moja ulilosikia.

Mfano 3: Andika sentensi tatu kuhusu familia yako ukitumia maneno mapya.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Dukani.
2. Explain Dukani to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dukani.
4. Show that you can: kutambua msamiati wa dukani ili kuutumia katika mawasiliano
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA (MAZOEZI / MAREKEBISHO)

1. Write five sentences about Dukani. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Dukani important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU 8: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua msamiati wa dukani ili kuutumia katika mawasiliano
2. kusoma maneno yanayohusiana na shughuli za dukani ili kujenga usomaji bora
3. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa dukani ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza
4. kutumia msamiati wa dukani katika sentensi sahihi ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na uuzaji na ununuzi ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma 105 f) kuthamini shughuli za biashara. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
